definition: Observable opening and closing of the eyes as a normal physiological event.
inclusion_criterion: Complete visible closure followed by reopening of the eyelids within the capture frame sequence.
exclusion_criterion: Partial closure not visible; eye state not assessable (use UNOBSERVABLE).
source_label_relation: Baseline behavior for altered-pattern analysis; most source datasets do not label individual blinks - derived by human observation.

definition: Single eye-closure event lasting longer than the normal blink range for the session protocol.
inclusion_criterion: Visible closure exceeding the blink-duration threshold defined in the annotation manual (threshold to be fixed in pilot).
exclusion_criterion: Normal-duration blink; closure not visible due to occlusion (UNOBSERVABLE); ambiguous duration (UNCERTAIN).
source_label_relation: Related to source labels such as eyes: sleepy (NTHU-DDD) and normalized eye opening (DROZY) - mapping PARTIAL pending threshold alignment.

definition: Multiple eye-closure events occurring in sequence within a defined observation interval.
inclusion_criterion: Two or more closure events within the interval defined in the annotation manual.
exclusion_criterion: Isolated single closure; closures separated beyond the defined interval.
source_label_relation: No direct source label found in the inventoried datasets - requires human observation.

definition: Perceptible change in blink rate or rhythm compared to the participant baseline within the same session.
inclusion_criterion: Visible deviation from the session baseline blink pattern sustained over the observation interval.
exclusion_criterion: Normal variation; insufficient observation time (UNCERTAIN).
source_label_relation: Target of source labels advertised as fatigue levels (DMD) - semantics UNVERIFIED until annotation files are inspected.

definition: Extended closing of the eyes interpreted as a drowsiness episode indicator.
inclusion_criterion: Visible prolonged closure exceeding the sleepiness threshold in the annotation manual.
exclusion_criterion: Normal blink; closure not assessable (UNOBSERVABLE).
source_label_relation: Maps from source labels: drowsy/low vigilant (UTA-RLDD - PARTIAL), drowsy frame labels (NTHU-DDD - PARTIAL), session conditions Awake/Drowsy (UL-DD - PARTIAL), sleepy eyes (NTHU-DDD - PARTIAL).

definition: Repeated episodes of eye closure within a short observation interval as drowsiness evidence.
inclusion_criterion: Two or more closure events within the sleepiness interval defined in the annotation manual.
exclusion_criterion: Single isolated closure; ambiguous events (UNCERTAIN).
source_label_relation: No direct source label in inventoried datasets - requires human observation.

definition: Observable yawning episode (mouth opening characteristic of a yawn).
inclusion_criterion: Visible yawn sequence with characteristic mouth opening/closing.
exclusion_criterion: Talking or mouth movement that is not a yawn; mouth not visible (UNOBSERVABLE).
source_label_relation: Maps from: YawDD yawning situations (PARTIAL - videos unlabeled), NTHU-DDD mouth: yawning (PARTIAL), DMD yawn activities (PARTIAL). CASO 3 applies: preserve original intervals and verify temporally.

definition: Participant self-report of sleepiness (e.g. KSS), stored separately from visual observation.
inclusion_criterion: Valid self-report record (KSS value or equivalent) associated with the session/timepoint.
exclusion_criterion: Inferred sleepiness without self-report; engine scores (forbidden as ground truth).
source_label_relation: Maps as COMPLEMENTARY from: UTA-RLDD KSS basis, DROZY KSS per PVT, UL-DD KSS every 4 min. CASO 2: never converted to visual PRESENT.

definition: Persistent deviation of gaze away from the forward road scene.
inclusion_criterion: Visible gaze directed away from the forward scene for the persistence interval defined in the annotation manual.
exclusion_criterion: Momentary glance within normal scanning; gaze not assessable (UNOBSERVABLE); ambiguous (UNCERTAIN).
source_label_relation: Maps PARTIAL from: DMD gaze-on-road labels (inverse; persistence undefined), activity classes implying eyes-off-road (AUC/State Farm/DMD - gaze not annotated).

definition: Persistent deviation of head orientation away from the forward driving posture.
inclusion_criterion: Visible head orientation deviation sustained for the persistence interval defined in the annotation manual.
exclusion_criterion: Normal head movement; nodding as drowsiness (not mapped here); head not visible (UNOBSERVABLE).
source_label_relation: Maps PARTIAL from: NTHU-DDD head: looking aside (frame-level), reaching-behind activities (AUC/State Farm/DMD - PARTIAL).

definition: Visible presence of a phone in the scene WITHOUT demonstrated use.
inclusion_criterion: Phone visible in frame or hand.
exclusion_criterion: Phone usage (use DIST_004); phone not visible.
source_label_relation: No source in the inventory labels presence-only; CASO 4: presence alone must NEVER be converted to distraction PRESENT. Kept as explicit non-distraction evidence code.

definition: Observable use of a phone (calling/texting) associated with attention directed away from the driving task.
inclusion_criterion: Visible phone usage (held to ear, texting look-down) with attention deviation evidence in the same interval.
exclusion_criterion: Phone present but unused (DIST_003); usage not visible (UNOBSERVABLE).
source_label_relation: Maps PARTIAL from: AUC phone/text classes (image-level), State Farm c1-c4 (image-level), DMD talking/texting phone (temporal VCD). CASO 4: temporal association with attention deviation required.

definition: Face partially occluded (hand object glasses part of face) for an interval.
inclusion_criterion: Any visible occlusion reducing facial observability.
exclusion_criterion: Full face visible.
source_label_relation: Quality flag - applies to any source (e.g. DMD yawn with hand). Not a behavior label; used to justify UNOBSERVABLE decisions.

definition: Face fully occluded or out of frame for an interval.
inclusion_criterion: Face not visible at all.
exclusion_criterion: Partial visibility (QUALITY_001).
source_label_relation: Quality flag - drives UNOBSERVABLE classification for behavior domains.

definition: Insufficient lighting to assess facial/ocular behavior for an interval.
inclusion_criterion: Visual assessment not possible due to lighting.
exclusion_criterion: Assessment possible despite suboptimal lighting.
source_label_relation: Quality flag - relevant for night scenarios (NTHU-DDD Night_* etc.).

definition: Face cannot be reliably localized/detected for an interval.
inclusion_criterion: No usable face region.
exclusion_criterion: Face detectable.
source_label_relation: Quality flag - justifies UNOBSERVABLE when capture prevents evaluation.

definition: Mouth visibly open in a single cataloged frame without sufficient temporal context to confirm a yawn.
inclusion_criterion: Visible mouth opening with ambiguous cause (talking vs yawning); recorded as UNCERTAIN.
exclusion_criterion: Clearly observable yawn (use SLEEP_003); mouth not visible (UNOBSERVABLE).
source_label_relation: Frame-level human observation from the review sheets; never derived from filename or engine scores.

definition: Eyes visibly closed in a single cataloged frame without inferred duration.
inclusion_criterion: Visible eyelid closure in the observed frame; may be a blink (confidence MEDIUM).
exclusion_criterion: Eyes open; occlusion by sunglasses or hand (UNOBSERVABLE).
source_label_relation: Frame-level human observation; temporal persistence is not inferred from a single frame.

definition: Gaze visibly directed away from the forward scene in a single cataloged frame.
inclusion_criterion: Averted gaze direction recorded relative to the image (RIGHT/LEFT/UP/DOWN combinations).
exclusion_criterion: Forward gaze; eyes not visible (UNOBSERVABLE); ambiguous deviation (UNCERTAIN).
source_label_relation: Frame-level human observation; persistence must be verified before treating as sustained distraction (protocol §2.3).

definition: Hand visibly raised near the face or head in a single cataloged frame without confirmed phone use.
inclusion_criterion: Visible hand movement in the observed frame.
exclusion_criterion: Confirmed phone usage (DIST_004); hand not visible.
source_label_relation: Frame-level human observation; the presence of a hand or phone alone is never converted to distraction PRESENT.
